# `ar`

## `ar.duration`

`ar.duration(value: timedelta, /) -> str`

*filter*

A duration in words, largest unit first: «أسبوع ويومان».

- ``{{ x | ar.duration }}`` with `x = datetime.timedelta(days=9)` → ``أسبوع ويومان``
- ``{{ x | ar.duration }}`` with `x = datetime.timedelta(seconds=9000)` → ``ساعتان وثلاثون دقيقةً``

## `ar.equals`

`ar.equals(value: str, other: str, /, preset: Literal['names', 'search', 'sort'] = 'names') -> bool`

*filter, test*

Return True if both strings match after normalizing them. Also a test.

- ``{{ 'عبدالله' | ar.equals('عبد الله') }}`` → ``True``
- ``{{ 'أحمد' is ar.equals('احمد') }}`` → ``True``
- ``{{ 'أحمد' is ar.equals('محمد') }}`` → ``False``

## `ar.format_date`

`ar.format_date(value: date | HijriDate, fmt: str, /, *, months: Literal['levant', 'egyptian', 'maghreb', 'levant_with_egyptian'] = 'levant', digits: Literal['latin', 'arabic', 'persian'] = 'latin') -> str`

*filter*

Format with Arabic names: strftime directives, `%O` for the ordinal day.

Datetimes also take `%H %I %M %S %p`. Hijri dates use Hijri month names (`months` is
ignored).

- ``{{ d | ar.format_date('%A %d %B %Y') }}`` with `d = datetime.date(2026, 1, 5)` → ``الاثنين 05 كانون الثاني 2026``
- ``{{ d | ar.format_date('%O من %B', months='egyptian', digits='arabic') }}`` with `d = datetime.date(2026, 1, 5)` → ``الخامس من يناير``
- ``{{ dt | ar.format_date('%d/%m/%Y %I:%M %p') }}`` with `dt = datetime.datetime(2026, 1, 5, 14, 30)` → ``05/01/2026 02:30 مساءً``

## `ar.format_money`

`ar.format_money(value: int | Decimal | str, currency: Currency, /, *, digits: Literal['latin', 'arabic', 'persian'] = 'arabic', grouping: str | None = '٬', decimal: str = '٫', places: int | None = None) -> str`

*filter*

Format an amount with the currency symbol. Money is never rounded.

- ``{{ salary | ar.format_money(syp) }}`` with `salary = Decimal('12500')`, `syp = Currency(...)` → ``١٢٬٥٠٠ ل.س``
- ``{{ salary | ar.format_money(syp, digits='latin', grouping=',', decimal='.') }}`` with `salary = Decimal('12500.5')`, `syp = Currency(...)` → ``12,500.50 ل.س``

## `ar.format_number`

`ar.format_number(value: int | Decimal | str, /, *, digits: Literal['latin', 'arabic', 'persian'] = 'latin', grouping: str | None = ',', decimal: str = '.', places: int | None = None) -> str`

*filter*

Format a number with a digit set, thousands separator and decimal mark.

- ``{{ x | ar.format_number }}`` with `x = Decimal('1234567.5')` → ``1,234,567.5``
- ``{{ x | ar.format_number(digits='arabic', grouping='٬', decimal='٫', places=2) }}`` with `x = Decimal('1234567.5')` → ``١٬٢٣٤٬٥٦٧٫٥٠``

## `ar.format_percent`

`ar.format_percent(value: int | Decimal | str, /, *, digits: Literal['latin', 'arabic', 'persian'] = 'latin', grouping: str | None = ',', decimal: str = '.', places: int | None = None) -> str`

*filter*

Format a fraction as a percentage with the `٪` sign.

- ``{{ x | ar.format_percent }}`` with `x = Decimal('0.25')` → ``25٪``
- ``{{ x | ar.format_percent(digits='arabic') }}`` with `x = Decimal('0.125')` → ``١٢.٥٪``

## `ar.month_name`

`ar.month_name(value: date, /, style: Literal['levant', 'egyptian', 'maghreb', 'levant_with_egyptian'] = 'levant') -> str`

*filter*

The month's Arabic name: «كانون الثاني», «يناير», …

- ``{{ d | ar.month_name }}`` with `d = datetime.date(2026, 1, 5)` → ``كانون الثاني``
- ``{{ d | ar.month_name('levant_with_egyptian') }}`` with `d = datetime.date(2026, 1, 5)` → ``كانون الثاني (يناير)``

## `ar.normalize`

`ar.normalize(value: str, /, preset: Literal['names', 'search', 'sort'] = 'search') -> str`

*filter*

Normalize Arabic text with a preset: `search`, `names` or `sort`.

- ``{{ x | ar.normalize }}`` with `x = 'أَحْمَد'` → ``احمد``
- ``{{ x | ar.normalize('names') }}`` with `x = 'عبدالله'` → ``عبد الله``

## `ar.ordinal`

`ar.ordinal(value: int, /, gender: Literal['masculine', 'feminine'] = 'masculine', *, definite: bool = True, case: Literal['nominative', 'accusative', 'genitive'] = 'nominative') -> str`

*filter*

The ordinal of a number from 1 to 100: «الثالث».

- ``{{ 3 | ar.ordinal }}`` → ``الثالث``
- ``{{ 3 | ar.ordinal('feminine') }}`` → ``الثالثة``
- ``{{ 3 | ar.ordinal(definite=false, case='accusative') }}`` → ``ثالثًا``

## `ar.ordinal_adverb`

`ar.ordinal_adverb(value: int, /) -> str`

*filter*

The list marker for a number from 1 to 100: «أولًا»، «ثانيًا».

- ``{{ 2 | ar.ordinal_adverb }}`` → ``ثانيًا``

## `ar.parse_date`

`ar.parse_date(value: str, fmt: str, /, *, months: Literal['levant', 'egyptian', 'maghreb', 'levant_with_egyptian'] | None = None) -> date`

*filter*

Strictly parse Arabic date text, in any digit set. `months=None` accepts every style.

- ``{{ x | ar.parse_date('%d %B %Y') }}`` with `x = '٥ كانون الثاني ٢٠٢٦'` → ``2026-01-05``
- ``{{ x | ar.parse_date('%d %B %Y') | date.weekday }}`` with `x = '5 يناير 2026'` → ``0``

## `ar.parse_datetime`

`ar.parse_datetime(value: str, fmt: str, /, *, months: Literal['levant', 'egyptian', 'maghreb', 'levant_with_egyptian'] | None = None) -> datetime`

*filter*

Strictly parse Arabic datetime text, in any digit set.

- ``{{ x | ar.parse_datetime('%d/%m/%Y %H:%M') }}`` with `x = '٠٥/٠١/٢٠٢٦ ١٤:٣٠'` → ``2026-01-05 14:30:00``

## `ar.parse_number`

`ar.parse_number(value: str, /, *, decimal: Literal['.', ',', '،', '٫'] | None = None) -> Decimal`

*filter*

Parse a number written in any digit set into an exact `Decimal`.

- ``{{ x | ar.parse_number }}`` with `x = '١٬٢٣٤٫٥'` → ``1234.5``
- ``{{ x | ar.parse_number(decimal=',') }}`` with `x = '1.234,5'` → ``1234.5``

## `ar.reshape_only`

`ar.reshape_only(value: str, /) -> str`

*filter*

Join the letters but keep the logical order. Needs `jinja-types[shape]`.

- ``{{ 'سلام' | ar.reshape_only | length }}`` → ``3``

## `ar.shape`

`ar.shape(value: str, /) -> str`

*filter*

Join the letters and reorder for left-to-right drawing. Needs `jinja-types[shape]`.

- ``{{ 'سلام' | ar.shape | length }}`` → ``3``

## `ar.since`

`ar.since(value: datetime, /, now: datetime | None = None) -> str`

*filter*

How long ago (or how far ahead) the datetime is, in its largest whole unit.

- ``{{ dt | ar.since(now) }}`` with `dt = datetime.datetime(2026, 1, 5, 14, 30)`, `now = datetime.datetime(2026, 1, 8, 14, 30)` → ``منذ ثلاثة أيام``
- ``{{ dt | ar.since(now) }}`` with `dt = datetime.datetime(2026, 1, 5, 14, 30)`, `now = datetime.datetime(2026, 1, 5, 12, 30)` → ``بعد ساعتين``

## `ar.sort`

`ar.sort(value: Iterable[Any], /, *, key: str | Callable[[Any], object] | None = None, reverse: bool = False) -> list[Any]`

*filter*

Sort in Arabic alphabetical order. `key` is an attribute name or a macro.

- ``{{ names | ar.sort | join('، ') }}`` with `names = ['مريم', 'أحمد', 'باسل']` → ``أحمد، باسل، مريم``
- ``{{ names | ar.sort(reverse=true) | join('، ') }}`` with `names = ['مريم', 'أحمد', 'باسل']` → ``مريم، باسل، أحمد``
- ``{{ people | ar.sort(key='name') | map(attribute='age') | join('|') }}`` with `people = [{'name': 'مريم', 'age': 30}, {'name': 'باسل', 'age': 41}]` → ``41|30``

## `ar.to_arabic_digits`

`ar.to_arabic_digits(value: str | int | Decimal, /) -> str`

*filter*

Replace Latin and Persian digits with Arabic-Indic digits.

- ``{{ 'Room 2026' | ar.to_arabic_digits }}`` → ``Room ٢٠٢٦``

## `ar.to_hijri`

`ar.to_hijri(value: date, /) -> HijriDate`

*filter*

The same day in the Hijri (Umm al-Qura) calendar. Needs `jinja-types[hijri]`.

- ``{{ d | ar.to_hijri | ar.format_date('%d %B %Y') }}`` with `d = datetime.date(2026, 1, 5)` → ``16 رجب 1447``
- ``{{ d | ar.to_hijri }}`` with `d = datetime.date(2026, 1, 5)` → ``1447-07-16``

## `ar.to_latin_digits`

`ar.to_latin_digits(value: str | int | Decimal, /) -> str`

*filter*

Replace Arabic-Indic and Persian digits with Latin digits.

- ``{{ x | ar.to_latin_digits }}`` with `x = '٢٠٢٦'` → ``2026``

## `ar.to_persian_digits`

`ar.to_persian_digits(value: str | int | Decimal, /) -> str`

*filter*

Replace Latin and Arabic-Indic digits with Persian digits.

- ``{{ 2026 | ar.to_persian_digits }}`` → ``۲۰۲۶``

## `ar.to_words`

`ar.to_words(value: int | Decimal | str, /, unit: Noun | None = None) -> str`

*filter*

Write a number in Arabic words (تفقيط), optionally counting a noun or a currency.

- ``{{ 1234 | ar.to_words }}`` → ``ألف ومئتان وأربعة وثلاثون``
- ``{{ 3 | ar.to_words(hour) }}`` with `hour = Noun(...)` → ``ثلاث ساعات``
- ``{{ salary | ar.to_words(syp) }}`` with `salary = Decimal('1500.25')`, `syp = Currency(...)` → ``ألف وخمسمئة ليرة سورية وخمسة وعشرون قرشًا``

## `ar.weekday_name`

`ar.weekday_name(value: date, /) -> str`

*filter*

The weekday's Arabic name: «الاثنين» … «الأحد».

- ``{{ d | ar.weekday_name }}`` with `d = datetime.date(2026, 1, 5)` → ``الاثنين``
